dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: Hello there. Is there any legal service I can provide?

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: Well, I wish I could've become a Champion Duelist, but that's not happening in this life, I reckon.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: I can't fight — like, I really can't. I'm the type who can knock herself on the head with a sheathed sword...

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: But if there's a talent I do have, that's searching. As long as the case details are clear, I can quickly find all the relevant legal clauses.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: To be precise, I do consultancy on how to "escape the law."

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: My goal is to let my clients avoid run-ins with Champion Duelists and avoid entering the theater — except to enjoy performances, that is.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: This is not hard to do. All legal systems have their flaws — and I know them as well as I do the holes in my socks.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: Hmm... Speaking of that, I should probably spend some Mora to get a pair of new ones.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: Ah, what a shame... I mean, how fortunate!
